title: How Birds With GPS and Audio Sensors Track Hidden Fishing Boats
summary: Researchers are using seabirds equipped with GPS and audio gear to detect vessels that operate with no tracking signals and to assess the environmental hazards they pose.
caption: Northern gannets with audio recorders on their tails were used to detect fishing vessels in the North Atlantic.

title: Andrew Ramage Has Died. He Found Receipts for the ‘World’s First Millionaire.’
summary: An archaeologist, he unearthed evidence that the saying “as rich as Croesus” is apt: King Croesus was very, very wealthy. Mr. Ramage died at 87.

title: The N.F.L. Player Who Left Football for Math
summary: John Urschel left the game in part because of health risks. Now he’s scoring points in a new profession, but A.I. looms as a different kind of career hazard.
caption: John Urschel at his home in Belmont, Mass., this month.
